anti_slop_gate.fallback_rewrite_prompt: Rewrite in austere Anglo-Saxon prose under 40 words. Use active physical verbs. Zero emotional adjectives. Name at least two registered physical objects from the scene.

FLIRT.description: Carnal weaponization, suggestive physical banter, transactional seduction, somatic intimacy.
FLIRT.mechanics: Tests interpersonal boundary clearance; grants leverage on receptive targets but risks alienation on puritan interlocutors.

PATRONIZE.description: Aristocratic condescension, infantalizing interlocutor, asserting institutional supremacy.
PATRONIZE.tactical_effect: Lowers target morale on success; provokes rage berserk on failure.
PATRONIZE.mechanics: Applies severe psychological pressure using class dominance; success reduces target composure by 2, failure triggers instant combat aggression.

CRUEL.description: Visceral wartime leverage, twisting psychological knives, threatening somatic mutilation.
CRUEL.tactical_effect: Forces immediate morale check; permanently damages neutral faction standing.
CRUEL.mechanics: Demands raw Will check vs target; success extracts desperate compliance, failure cements implacable enmity and incurs negative faction delta.

BRIBE.description: Cold transactional corruption using rations, captured narcotics, or First World coinage.
BRIBE.tactical_effect: Bypasses ideological resistance at the cost of inventory wealth.
BRIBE.mechanics: Substitutes wealth/supplies for persuasion DC; success transfers resource silently, failure forfeits offer and alerts commanding officers.
